market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $85 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$102; reaching $85 requires ~17% decline from current. Possible if geopolitical premium fully unwinds (some forecasts have $74.51 floor). With 30 days and high vol, plausible but not majority-likely. Most analyst ranges center $95-$110.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Speed of geopolitical risk unwind; OPEC+ production decisions.
